title: Nanvix SDK libc.lock
description: The Nanvix libc half of the SDK coupling, shared across all C providers. Serialized as TOML in libc.lock.

nanvix_tag.description: Nanvix libc release tag, injected as Z_NANVIX_RELEASE_TAG.

nanvix_commit.description: Exact commit the tag resolves to (empty until first real pin).

release_pattern.description: Glob for the release asset staged into the sysroot.

sysroot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the staged sysroot tarball (empty until first build).

c_abi.description: C ABI epoch string; the interop contract every C provider satisfies.

min_nanvix_os.description: Minimum Nanvix OS version this libc requires.
